entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about my new VeloBand GPS Tracker. I've had it for about ten days, but it's just not working correctly.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To best help you, could you clarify the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference?
It's definitely a technical fault. The main feature, the pulse sensor, seems to be completely broken. The readings are erratic, and most of the time the heart rate data won't sync to the app at all.

I understand. It sounds frustrating when a key feature isn't performing as expected. It sounds like the unit may be defective. My next step would be to transfer you to our technical support team who can troubleshoot this.

I appreciate the offer, but for a new device to be defective right out of the box, I'd honestly prefer to just return it for a refund. I've lost a bit of confidence in it. What are my options there? If a full refund isn't possible, would a discount code for a future purchase be on the table?
Of course, let me just pull up your order details and review the return eligibility. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It was delivered 12 days ago, on December 29th.
That sounds right. So, what does the policy say?

Yes, I've just checked our policy here. All our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 12, you are well within that window. I can absolutely process a full return for you.
Oh, 90 days? That's excellent, much better than I expected. A full refund is perfect. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I have initiated that return for you now. You will receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the defective VeloBand back in its original box and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That's great, Diana. I appreciate you making that so easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
